title: The Habit Loop and How to Hack It: The Mistake Keeping Habits Stuck
description: Understand the habit loop and why some behaviors happen automatically while others feel difficult to change. This guide explores behavior change, habit formation, self improvement psychology, and practical ways to reshape daily patterns. Learn how cues, routines, and rewards influence your actions, plus the deeper reason your brain stores repeated patterns to save energy. See the full framework here.
alt_text: Infographic explaining The Habit Loop with a focus on habit formation, showing the connection between cues, routines, and rewards while highlighting how behavior patterns can be redesigned.
hidden_hook: The blog reveals why the brain stores repeated cue-routine-reward sequences: they reduce the need to evaluate every decision from scratch.
